meta.title: Serenova — private journeys through Tanzania and Zanzibar
meta.description: A Lausanne travel house. Jenny designs tailor-made safaris in Tanzania, Zanzibar and Kilimanjaro — at your pace, never from a catalogue.

home.heroLede: Extraordinary places deserve a more personal way to travel. Discover the beauty of Tanzania and Zanzibar through journeys thoughtfully shaped around you.
home.philosophyQuote: Some journeys take you places. Others stay with you forever.
home.introBody: Some travellers dream of golden plains and iconic wildlife. Others picture quiet beach mornings, meaningful cultural encounters or a safari shared with the people they love. At Serenova, we listen first. Together with our local partners, we create a carefully considered journey that suits your interests, travel dates, pace and budget.
home.momentCaption: Your journey. Your rhythm. Your Africa.
home.operateBody: Jenny designs from Lausanne with guides who know the land as a home. Kenya and Uganda are composed on request — never as a catalogue.
home.operateZanzibar: Zanzibar — after the bush, or a journey of its own
home.tanzaniaBody: Serengeti, Ngorongoro, Tarangire, the migration. This is Serenova’s craft — composed day by day, never held in stock.
home.zanzibarBody: Pale sand, turquoise water, Stone Town. Often the exhale after safari — sometimes the journey itself.
home.wildernessTitle: Close enough to hear the land
home.wildernessBody: Game drives at first light, quiet camps, and the patience of a guide who knows when to stop. The wilderness is not a backdrop. It is the reason you came.
home.stylesTitle: Your own way of living Africa
home.stylesBody: Family, honeymoon, photography, walking, migration, or the beach after the bush. We start with you, not a catalogue.
home.staysTitle: Camps and lodges, chosen with care
home.staysBody: A library of stays Jenny actually works with — tents, crater-rim lodges and a house by the water. Nothing here is a guaranteed booking.
home.journeysBody: Jenny reads every request herself. These are ideas to begin from — prices shown are “from” figures, for two travellers, and must be confirmed.
home.aboutTitle: A passion for Tanzania, a journey in your image
home.aboutBody: Serenova began with a first journey to Tanzania that never quite ended. Jenny designs every itinerary by hand, with trusted local partners, and reviews every enquiry herself.

one.title: Personal by design
one.body: No two travellers are the same. Your itinerary should reflect what matters most to you, not a fixed template.

two.title: Local knowledge
two.body: We work with experienced partners on the ground, drawing on their understanding of Tanzania’s places, people and practical realities.

three.title: Thoughtful guidance
three.body: From first ideas to the details before departure, we help you make informed decisions and prepare with confidence.

home.ctaTitle: Start with a dream. We’ll help shape the journey.
home.ctaBody: Tell us when you would like to travel, who is joining you and what you hope to experience. We’ll help you explore the possibilities.

ndutu.name: Ndutu Wilderness
ndutu.body: Calving season, the crater, then the Serengeti. The rhythm of a real quote.

ocean.name: Bush & Ocean
ocean.body: Safari, then Zanzibar. The land, then the open water.

destinations.title: Destinations
destinations.lede: From mythic plains to slower islands. We almost always begin with Tanzania.

tanzania.title: Tanzania
tanzania.lede: Serengeti, Ngorongoro, Tarangire, Manyara, Ruaha, Selous. Sixteen places, one thread: yours.

zanzibar.title: Zanzibar
zanzibar.lede: Nungwi, Matemwe, Paje, Stone Town. The breath after the bush — or the whole journey.

kenya.title: Kenya
kenya.lede: Masai Mara and beyond. Not a catalogue: a conversation with Jenny.

uganda.title: Uganda
uganda.lede: Forests, gorillas, lakes. A page of intention, not a departure grid.

kilimanjaro.title: Kilimanjaro
kilimanjaro.lede: Machame, Lemosho, Marangu. The routes, the days, and what you actually need to know.

styles.title: Safari Styles
styles.lede: Different travellers. The same sense of wonder.

journeys.title: Journeys
journeys.lede: Seven possible starts. None of them are fixed. The real price is built by hand.

about.title: About
about.lede: A personal approach, local partners, and the time to listen before proposing.

journal.title: Journal
journal.lede: Seasons, families, the migration, what to pack. Three seed essays first — not an SEO mill.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lede: Write, call, or use WhatsApp. Jenny reads every message.

plan.title: Tell us about your dream journey
plan.lede: A few details will help us understand the experience you’re imagining. Share your preferred dates, how many people are travelling, your interests and any priorities we should know about.

private.a: Many journeys can be planned with a private vehicle or tailored accommodation arrangements, subject to route, availability and confirmation.

combine.q: Can I combine safari and Zanzibar?
combine.a: Yes, many travellers choose a mainland safari followed by a Zanzibar stay. The right order depends on flights, seasons and personal preferences.

sightings.q: Is a particular animal sighting guaranteed?
sightings.a: No. Wildlife moves freely and sightings depend on natural conditions.

dietary.a: Please share your requirements at the enquiry stage. We will discuss available arrangements and confirm what can be provided by each supplier.
